delivery.en: Parcels: often collected at an MRW, Zoom or Tealca office; or the door or porter
delivery.zh: 包裹常到 MRW、Zoom 或 Tealca 營業處取，或交門口、門房

readback.en: 04 mobiles go in short groups; 0 as cero; confirm dollars or bolívares
readback.zh: 手機常以 04 開頭、分短組唸，0 唸 cero；金額可能是美元或玻利瓦，要確認

fraud.en: A retained encomienda fee for MRW, Zoom, Tealca or IPOSTEL, or a bank OTP ask, are scams
fraud.zh: 假 MRW、Zoom 或 IPOSTEL 要補繳扣件費，或要銀行驗證碼的都是詐騙

habits.en: Tú is everyday; usted with strangers and elders. Say encomienda, agencia, pago móvil; not Nequi.
habits.zh: 日常用 tú，陌生人與長輩用 usted。用 encomienda、agencia、pago móvil。

stall_local.en: Get stuck on pago móvil failing, a spinning bank app, a power cut, or misplaced glasses.
stall_local.zh: 卡在 pago móvil 轉不出、銀行 App 一直轉、停電，或眼鏡放錯地方。

reason.en: Colombian wallet; Venezuela uses pago móvil and local banks
reason.zh: 哥倫比亞錢包，委內瑞拉用 pago móvil 與本地銀行

reason.en: Less typical than agencia pickup or portero
reason.zh: 所屬地區偏門房用語，當地更常到貨運營業處取件

talk_style_diff.en: Warmer and more tuteante than a generic latam blend; keep usted for strangers. Everyday talk may mix dollar and bolívar amounts; stay concrete and unhurried.
talk_style_diff.zh: 比籠統的拉美口氣更常 tú、更熱絡，對陌生人仍用 usted。金額可能夾美元與玻利瓦，語氣具體、不要催。

uncertain: 門房與「到營業處取件」哪個更常見，會依都市公寓與一般住家而異。
口頭報價時美元與玻利瓦混用很常見，但何種場合用哪一種，來源並未統一。
